what_it_does: Introduces BurstEngine, a distributed framework for training transformer models on extremely long sequences (over 1 million tokens). Training long sequences on multiple GPUs suffers from low utilization of floating-point operations when using standard tensor parallelism (dividing computation across GPUs) and context parallelism (dividing sequence length across GPUs). BurstEngine introduces topology-aware communication patterns to overlap data transfer with computation, selective checkpointing to save memory on long sequences, and workload balancing to handle attention masking operations.
